title: Daily 5, Thu 19 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: A cyclist rides a distance at 30 km/h and returns the same distance at 60 km/h. What is the average speed for the round trip?
For which value of k do kx + 2y = 5 and 6x + 4y = 10 have infinitely many solutions?
The ages of a mother and her daughter are in the ratio 7 : 2 and differ by 30 years. How old is the mother?
A trader gains 25% on cost price. What percentage of the selling price is his profit?
